verdict.stance: Overweight / Sovereign-Backed Hungarian Utility (Moody's Baa2 Stable Nov-26)
verdict.summary: Moody's revised MVM Group's Baa2 outlook to Stable in Nov-26 (joining Fitch BBB and S&P BBB-), recognizing solid cash generation (FY24 NPAT HUF 323.9bn) and sovereign strategic backing across Paks nuclear, grid, and gas supply. Watchpoint remains heavy decarbonization/LNG capex and Nov-27/Jun-28 refinancing.

positives: 100% Hungarian state-owned integrated utility (Paks nuclear, grids, Shah Deniz stake).
Moody's revised outlook to Stable (Baa2) in Nov-26; covenant leverage well contained.
Strategic Utilities market positioning in Hungary supporting resilient operating cash generation.
negatives: Large infrastructure/renewables capex and Hungarian regulatory tariff/windfall tax exposure.
Exposure to Hungary macro/FX volatility and sovereign spread widening cycles.
